import sys

def string_to_int_array(s):
    parts = s.strip().split()
    return [int(part) for part in parts]

def is_sub_array_balanced(arr, index):
    even_count = 0
    odd_count = 0
    for i in range(index + 1):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even_count += 1
        else:
            odd_count += 1
    return even_count == odd_count

def find_minimum_cost_index(arr, coins, used_cuts):
    min_index = -1
    min_cost = coins + 1
    for i in range(1, len(arr) - 1):
        cost = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1])
        if cost < min_cost and is_sub_array_balanced(arr, i) and i not in used_cuts:
            min_cost = cost
            min_index = i
    return min_index

def calculate_max_cuts(total, budget, arr):
    remaining_coins = budget
    cuts_count = 0
    used_indices = set()
    while remaining_coins > 0:
        index = find_minimum_cost_index(arr, remaining_coins, used_indices)
        if index >= 0:
            used_indices.add(index)
            cost = abs(arr[index] - arr[index + 1])
            remaining_coins -= cost
            cuts_count += 1
        else:
            break
    return cuts_count

def main():
    line1 = sys.stdin.readline()
    line2 = sys.stdin.readline()
    nb_arr = string_to_int_array(line1)
    a_arr = string_to_int_array(line2)
    n = nb_arr[0]
    b = nb_arr[1]
    max_cuts = calculate_max_cuts(n, b, a_arr)
    print(max_cuts)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
